title: Stale same-key slots consume Lookup's 4-owner fanout and hide a live owner
claim: Lookup caps matching slots at MaxSnapshotOwners before validating owner generation/state, so a finished owner's slot occupies a window; with >4 owners ever sharing a key, a remaining live owner (<=4 live) is omitted until an insertion reclaims the stale slot.

title: Lookup returns zero-range entries; propagation publishes zero-provenance roots for them
claim: A window inside an untainted gap yields an Entry with Ranges.Len()==0. Reporting skips it (no false taint), but propagation gates on snapshot.Len() and clones/adopts an empty-set root, spending root/byte/value budgets and allocations with no provenance.

title: Probe-exhaustion drop path is unreachable at design load
claim: At the 16,384-value process limit with churn and 240 compactions the max probe was 37/64; the probe-bound drop is only exercised through forceCollision unit tests.
